candidates.title: Schedules of Controlled Substances: Placement of Diphenidine in Schedule I

signals.causalPath: County-zone showers and lightning → possible brief local road, workforce or outdoor-activity interruption → dispatch and production continuity. The forecast concentration is south of the confirmed municipalities, and actual route, utility and site effects remain unverified.

signals.dateNote: NWS issued 04:07 CDT on 21 September. The 14:16 UTC collector snapshot contained no active alert matching Illinois SAME codes 017113, 017203 or 017179. hypotheses.title: Higher dairy prices threaten yogurt-melt margins.
